1.w: For the one directing according to “A Dove of Distant Oaks.” Of David. A Miktam in the seizing of him [by] the Philistines in Gath. Show favor to me, O God, for man would swallow me up; all the day fighting, he oppresses me.

2.w: My enemies swallow [me] up all the day, for many [are] fighting against me proudly.

3.w: [On] the day I am afraid, I will trust in You.

4.w: In God—His word I praise—in God do I trust. I will not fear; what can flesh do to me?

5.w: All the day they wrest my words; their thoughts [are] all for evil against me.

6.w: They gather together, they hide, they mark my steps when they lie in wait for my soul.

7.w: Over iniquity bring [no] escape for them! In [your] anger, may You cast down the nations, O God!

8.w: My wanderings You have counted; put my tears in Your bottle—are [they] not in Your book?

9.w: Then my enemies will turn back on the day I cry out. This I have known, that God [is] for me.

10.w: In God whose word I do praise, in YHWH whose word I praise—

11.w: in God I have put my trust! I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

12.w: Your vows, O God, [are] upon me; I will give thank offerings to You.

13.w: For You have delivered my soul from death, [Do You] not keep my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living!
